concerns.text: Inference tasks T010 (blind_inference) and T012 (guided_inference) do not record or fix a random seed, violating Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires all stochastic processes to be seeded.
No task measures the total wall‑clock execution time of the pipeline against the 6‑hour GitHub Actions budget required by SC‑004, making this success criterion impossible to verify.

Error classifier T014 implements categories {Syntax, Library, Runtime, Logic Transfer} but omits the Constitution‑VI mandated 'Logic Drift' category, weakening FR‑004 and violating the cross‑language fidelity principle.

Inconsistent naming of the error type: the specification (FR‑004) calls it 'Logic Transfer Failure' while the schema and T014 use 'Logic Transfer', creating ambiguity that can lead to weakened validation.
SC‑005 (Sandbox Stability Rate ≥ 99 %) is not captured by any verification step, leaving the acceptance criterion untestable.
